citation: Lugovaya, T.S. Biometric human identification based on electrocardiogram. Master's thesis, Electrotechnical University LETI, Saint Petersburg, 2005. ECG-ID Database, version 1.0.0, PhysioNet. https://physionet.org/content/ecgiddb/1.0.0/
leadNote: Signal 1 is the filtered lead I stored in the file.

exampleBeat.markMethod: R peaks are the file's beat annotations. Q and S are the lowest samples in the 80 ms before and after that R peak. T is the file's T annotation when one falls on this beat. P waves are not annotated in this dataset.
